title: Bucs agree to terms with Al-Quadin Muhammad on a one-year deal

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bucs agree to terms with Al-Quadin Muhammad on a one-year deal
sources.description: The Buccaneers have agreed to terms with edge rusher Al-Quadin Muhammad on a one-year deal with a maximum value of $6 million, Ian Rapoport of NFL Media reports.
